## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Identify the existing state owner; avoid adding a parallel store.

## Evidence

List the focused checks that ran and their results. Distinguish source build, runtime exercise, installation and release qualification. Report skips and missing assets.

## Boundaries

Note remaining work, compatibility or recovery implications. Exclude profiles, credentials, private documents, model weights and unreviewed art. Refresh the complete source manifest for a curated publication.

## Hive proposal and review

For Hive contributions, add the project and proposal links without disclosing private project details. Include your rationale, tested commit, checks and results, and the origins and applicable licenses of added source or assets. Follow the [Hive contributor guide](https://github.com/cr8ph8/ARCHi/blob/main/docs/hive-coding.md).

A different active moderator reviews the exact head and base commits in Hive. Changed source or base commits, draft conversion or retargeting require fresh verification and review. Hive approval is separate from GitHub's required independent review; this template is not an approval record.

After both reviews, an authorized maintainer merges on GitHub, then uses **Refresh GitHub** in Hive to reconcile the result. Hive does not merge automatically. Report a source merge separately from a hosted workflow pass, installation or user acceptance.
